hints.title: Timeline Event Decomposition
hints.text: A room is required whenever a meeting starts before the earliest ending ongoing meeting finishes.

hints.title: Two Separate Sorted Timelines
hints.text: Separate start times and end times into two individually sorted lists. Iterate through start times with a pointer tracking the earliest active end time.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Chronological Sweep
hints.text: Sort starts and ends independently. For each start time s, if s is strictly less than ends[end_idx], allocate an additional room. Otherwise, advance end_idx as that room has become free.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N log N) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating every minute across all intervals is bounded by maximum time values and is inefficient for large coordinates.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Chronological two-pointer sweep over sorted endpoints computes maximum overlapping intervals in O(N log N) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should understand both the min-heap approach and the two-pointer sorted endpoints sweep.
